## About Revenue Growth Management AI by BCG X

For consumer goods companies, [revenue growth management](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/pricing-revenue-management/revenue-growth-management) is becoming a core capability that defines competitive advantage. As data, analytics, and software become central to commercial performance, companies need more than manual analysis or disconnected revenue growth management software to thrive. Our solution is an end-to-end agentic RGM platform that combines historical data, consumer insights, and advanced machine learning to enable smarter decisions across [pricing](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/pricing-revenue-management/overview), promotions, assortment, mix, and trade investment.

By integrating advanced analytics, intuitive workflows, and [agentic AI](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/artificial-intelligence/ai-agents) in one modular platform, our solution helps organizations scale RGM with greater speed, precision, and consistency. The result is not just implementing technology, but also a scalable AI-driven revenue solution embedded across the organization that builds capabilities, redesigns workflows, and delivers sustained profitable value.

## Our Approach to Revenue Growth Management AI

Revenue Growth Management AI by BCG X enables [consumer goods](https://www.bcg.com/industries/consumer-products-industry/overview) companies to operationalize RGM at scale. BCG X works closely with clients to deploy and tailor the platform to their business, embedding it into core commercial processes and replacing fragmented, traditional revenue growth management software approaches. The platform is integrated into the client’s existing data, processes, and tools, working seamlessly with most existing TMP, IBP, and CRM solutions. It is configured to reflect categories, customers, and strategic priorities—ensuring adoption from day one.

BCG X then works side by side with commercial, RGM, and finance teams to translate insights into action, supporting planning cycles, accelerating decision-making, and enabling more effective retailer negotiations across pricing, promotions, assortment, and trade. Deployed within the client’s environment and transitioned over time, it enables organizations to sustain and scale RGM capabilities independently, without long-term reliance on external support.

At its core, the platform democratizes RGM expertise. By embedding advanced analytics, proven methodologies, and agentic RGM capabilities into intuitive workflows, it enables a broader set of users to make high-quality commercial decisions that drive growth.

## How Revenue Growth Management AI by BCG X Works

Revenue Growth Management AI by BCG X combines a set of integrated revenue growth management tools and AI-driven revenue solutions that support the full commercial life cycle, from strategic prioritization to execution and performance tracking. Designed specifically for consumer goods companies, the solution is modular by design, allowing companies to deploy a single module to solve a specific pain point and scale over time into a fully integrated AI-powered platform.
